attributes.provenance: src/game/audio/audio.c::AudioLoadPart free-slot scan loop (worktree GDL-Claude-ExactAudio, work_claim.exact-audio.20260831.v1, attempt.audioloadpart-structural-order-executed.20260831.v3, commit 445c62e72). Target +0x70 emits `bge ->+0x78` (loop latch) then `b ->+0x88` (past the `li r29,-1` sentinel); our object emits the single fused `blt ->+0x84`, a standing 1-instruction deficit that is the last cluster between 167/166 and exact. Four source spellings probed with tools/gdl/probe.py against a clean banked baseline, each rebuilt and re-scored: all four returned real 173, insns 167/166, opcode multiset 13t, and an IDENTICAL fndiff --ops cluster list - i.e. byte-identical objects.
attributes.scope: MWCC GC 1.2.5 family with the per-TU flags in configure.py; applies to any residual whose only remaining gap is a target-side unfused conditional-over-unconditional branch pair (`bCOND <next-block>` immediately followed by `b <far-label>`) where the reconstruction emits one inverted conditional branch instead. Companion boundary case to claim.law.if-else-arm-swap-controls-fallthrough-placement (which moves which ARM is fallthrough, and does work) and claim.law.guard-polarity-restructure-fixes-count-parity-not-form (which can add or drop an incidental branch, but at a guard clause, not at a loop exit).

subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value: MWCC canonicalizes every source spelling of a single-statement conditional exit out of a counted loop into ONE inverted conditional branch, so a target that shows the UNFUSED pair (`bCOND` to the loop latch followed by `b` to a far label) cannot be reproduced by respelling the exit, and the branch-spelling axis should be closed on first diagnosis rather than iterated. Four spellings measured byte-identical on the same function: `if (v < 0) goto L;`, `if (v >= 0) continue; goto L;`, `if (v < 0) goto L; else continue;`, and `if (v < 0) goto L; else { }` (an explicit empty else, the one lowering that should have preserved the naive front-end pair). TWO SCREENING SHORTCUTS THAT SAVE WHOLE PROBES, both established here. (1) DO NOT reach for a peephole flag or a scoped `#pragma peephole off` for this shape on a demo-family TU: cflags_demo already rewrites `-O4,p` to plain `-O4`, so peephole is ALREADY OFF at the TU level and the fusion is MWCC front-end basic-block layout, not a peephole. Read the TU's actual cflags in configure.py BEFORE spending a probe or a pragma on any branch-fusion theory - the `-O4,p` -> `-O4` rewrite is easy to miss because the flag list is built by comprehension. (2) RUN tools/gdl/shapegrep.py ON THE EXACT OPCODE RUN FIRST. Here `shapegrep.py bge,b,addi,addi,bdnz` returned exactly ONE function in the entire target image - AudioLoadPart itself - proving no byte-exact positive control exists anywhere to read the spelling off, which is decisive evidence that the shape is not a reproducible source idiom. A shapegrep run that returns only your own non-exact function is a stop signal for the source axis, and it costs one command against several build cycles. The genuinely useful positive controls found by widening the query (`b,addi,bdnz` / `b,addi,addi,bdnz`) all had a NON-EMPTY fallthrough block before the `b` - e.g. audio.c::AudioSoundPlaying, byte-exact in the same TU, whose `return 1;` inside the loop compiles to `li r3,1` then `b epilogue`, and whose `bge` therefore branches over two instructions rather than over a lone branch. That is the discriminant: MWCC fuses the pair only when the block between the conditional and its far target is EMPTY, and no C spelling makes an empty block non-empty without inventing a statement. Related dead axis measured in the same pass: rewriting the loop as `do { } while` to change the front-end construct lost the counted-loop transform outright (mtctr/bdnz disappeared, 165 insns, multiset regressed 13t -> 16t), so loop-construct substitution is not a workaround either. Classify this residual REGISTER_ONLY/SCHEDULE-adjacent, record it, and spend the budget on the function's other clusters.
